concerns.text: Verification for T006 only checks for keys r2_mean, r2_std, mae_mean, null_model_r2, and feature_importances, but the required ModelArtifact schema (artifact.schema.yaml) also mandates fdr_corrected_pvalues, collinearity_flag, correlations, feature_importance_ci, and the exact associational_statement. Omitting these fields weakens FR‑008, FR‑007, FR‑010 and violates the schema.

T010 creates separate VIF diagnostic JSON files but never sets the boolean collinearity_flag required by the ModelArtifact schema, nor does it produce the correlations object. This drops the FR‑007 flagging requirement and breaks schema validation.

Bootstrap feature‑importance results are written to feature_importance_bootstrap.json and a summary CSV, yet the ModelArtifact schema requires a feature_importance_ci object inside the JSON artifact. The current tasks leave this acceptance criterion unaddressed.

The summary CSV generated by T015 is not incorporated into any ModelArtifact JSON, so SC‑002 (bootstrapped importance stability) is not captured in the required artifact, weakening the success‑criteria.

The plan introduces a new functional requirement (iterative removal of predictors with VIF > 5) that is not present in the specification. This constitutes unapproved scope creep and, if implemented, would narrow the predictor set contrary to FR‑003, which expects the three original descriptors to be used (only flagged, not removed).

T012 runs verify_artifacts.py which validates metrics.json against artifact.schema.yaml, yet earlier tasks (T006, T010, T014) do not produce the required schema fields. This creates an internal inconsistency and effectively weakens the verification step.

Integration test for T003 mocks Zenodo responses. FR‑001 requires real‑call testing of the ingestion pipeline; using mocks for verification does not satisfy the ‘real‑call’ requirement and therefore weakens the functional requirement.
